commands.name: list
commands.summary: List the names of the Ouro UI registry items, in registry order. Pass filter to keep only the names that contain it, such as 'dialog' or 'button'. Use a name from this list with get_item_install or get_item_docs.

filter.description: Keep only the items whose name contains this text, ignoring case.

commands.name: install
commands.summary: Return the shadcn command that adds one registry item to an app, pinned to the newest Ouro UI release. Run the command as it is; it installs the item and the Ouro items it needs. The name is one from list_registry_items.

args.name: name
args.description: The registry item's name, such as dialog.

commands.name: docs
commands.summary: Return the docs page address for one registry item and, when the docs are in the repository, the page's Markdown: its purpose, props, examples and when to use something else. The name is one from list_registry_items.

args.name: name
args.description: The registry item's name, such as dialog.
